question: After real gateway burst evidence is added, does the maintainer want to accept this per-session serialization boundary as the canonical hook-delivery behavior?
rationale: The PR changes concurrency behavior around persisted cron session lifecycle ownership, and the protected label requires explicit maintainer judgment on the intended queue identity and operational tradeoff.

options.title: Accept canonical per-session FIFO
options.body: Approve once a redacted live gateway burst proves ordered delivery and the maintainer confirms the queue key follows the effective cron agent-session identity.

options.title: Prefer a retry policy
options.body: Replace or supplement serialization with bounded lifecycle-claim retries if the intended product behavior is to preserve concurrency for aliases that resolve to one session.

recommendation.title: Accept canonical per-session FIFO
recommendation.body: Approve once a redacted live gateway burst proves ordered delivery and the maintainer confirms the queue key follows the effective cron agent-session identity.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation contributor is the best available routing candidate in the supplied evidence, though broader ownership history was not available.
